changelog: Orion 3.2 — Orion is now his own API: the core powers (make with mastery verify-and-repair, solve, search, read, speak, edit, deploy, rules) are built into the app and always on, no pairing needed. The web computer lives inside Orion too and starts when Orion starts. Orion carries his own Linux (shell + Python) in a terminal that also controls the phone. Type or Call with one shared memory, Orion asks a few questions first when an idea is thin, and checks for updates on its own — this is the last manual download.
